:::{#hero-heading}

[<br><br><br>I'm an astrophysics PhD student at the University of Helsinki and part of the [GCG](https://gcg-helsinki.github.io) research group. I use X-ray and optical observations to study the large-scale structure. Currently, I'm interested in how feedback from black holes affects the baryonic content of galaxy clusters and redistributes the matter on megaparsec scales.]{style="font-size: 27px;"}
